_what: The lists the answer engine reads besides the person's files and records, as DATA read by src/answer-tools.mjs. `content` is content an app or a Marketplace tool sends in to be answered from: each item is one row of the content list keyed by (root, id) -- its row id is `row_id_prefix` + the first `row_id_hex` hex digits of the BLAKE3 of the root and the id, so sending the same item again changes that one row -- and every root is a row of the roots list a person or an AI makes first (the link field `root` requires its target, so content sent to a root nobody made is refused). `reports` is the work queue of answers people said were wrong or missing: a report is a row with an assignee, a rating and a status; `statuses` are the states a report moves through, each naming the fields it `requires` before a report may hold it and the date field it `stamps` when it starts holding it; `comments` are rows of their own linked to the report. The search lanes over these lists (src/search.json lanes `indexed-content` and `corrected-answers`) make an item and a solved report's corrected answer sources the next answer cites, with the date it was last changed (`at`). Lists are made on first use by /lists/<id>/ensure, so a person who never uses them keeps none.

roots.label: Content sent in for answers
roots.about: Places apps and tools send content into, so answers can cite it.

list.label: Content for answers
list.about: Content apps and tools sent in, answered from like your own notes.

fields.label: Its id where it came from

assignees.label: Your AIs
assignees.about: Names read directly from your native AI records. Choosing a name gives no connection, delivery or readiness authority; no identities are copied here.

list.label: Answers to fix
list.about: Questions whose answer was wrong or missing, until someone fixes them.

words.no_root: Name the root (a place made with save_content_root) and give at most {most} items, each with an id and a title.
words.bad_item: Item {index} needs an id and a title, at most {chars} characters of text, and an id with no slash.
words.bad_report: Give the question and what was wrong with its answer ({issues}).
words.no_report: There is no answer report {report_id}; read_answer_reports lists them.
words.needs: A report is {status} only with {fields}: give them in the same call.
words.bad_rating: rating is a whole number from {min} to {max}.
words.bad_comment: Give report_id and the comment's text.
